region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis medication writer HCMADB01, LINKed with a COMMAREA: after the length checks it INSERTs a MEDICATION row (medication id DEFAULT, an identity column), reads the new id with IDENTITY_VAL_LOCAL and returns it in CA-PRESCRIPTION-ID. Tables come from the estate's @DB2CRE.jcl (HCZMSA1). scenarios.name: add-medication
scenarios.why: one MEDICATION row for patient 1 (identity default), IDENTITY_VAL_LOCAL returned in CA-PRESCRIPTION-ID, CA-RETURN-CODE '00'

scenarios.name: add-second-medication
scenarios.why: a second row: the identity column hands out the next id

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE (LINK HCAZERRS) then ABEND HCCA

scenarios.name: short-commarea
scenarios.why: one byte under the 18-byte header: '98', RETURN before the INSERT

scenarios.name: unknown-patient
scenarios.why: patient 99 has no PATIENT row: the foreign key fails the INSERT (SQLCODE not 0), '90', error message written, task returns
